import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Fill NaN in 'Sleep Disorder' with 'None' for clearer categorization
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
# Order BMI Category for better visualization logic
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)

# --- Visualization Setup ---
# Set a clean and modern plot style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", rc={"axes.facecolor": "#f0f0f0", "figure.facecolor": "white"})

# Create the figure and axes for the subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12), gridspec_kw={'hspace': 0.4, 'wspace': 0.3})
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Sleep Health Analysis by Occupation', fontsize=22, weight='bold', y=0.98)

# --- Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs. Quality by Occupation ---
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Occupation',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(30, 200),
    palette='viridis',
    ax=ax1,
    alpha=0.8
)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs. Quality by Occupation', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend(title='Occupation & Activity', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0.)

# --- Plot 2: Stress Level Distribution by Sleep Disorder ---
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sns.violinplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Disorder',
    y='Stress Level',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    palette='magma',
    inner='quartile',
    legend=False,
    ax=ax2
)
ax2.set_title('Stress Level Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=10)


# --- Plot 3: Heart Rate vs. Daily Steps by BMI Category ---
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
sns.kdeplot(
    data=df,
    x='Daily Steps',
    y='Heart Rate',
    hue='BMI Category',
    hue_order=bmi_order,
    fill=True,
    alpha=0.6,
    palette='coolwarm',
    ax=ax3
)
ax3.set_title('Heart Rate & Daily Steps Density by BMI', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Resting Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)


# --- Plot 4: Average Sleep Metrics by Gender ---
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Melt the dataframe to plot multiple metrics
metrics_df = df.melt(
    id_vars='Gender',
    value_vars=['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Stress Level'],
    var_name='Metric',
    value_name='Value'
)
sns.barplot(
    data=metrics_df,
    x='Metric',
    y='Value',
    hue='Gender',
    palette={'Male': '#1f77b4', 'Female': '#ff7f0e'},
    ax=ax4,
    ci=None
)
ax4.set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Gender', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Health Metric', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Value', fontsize=12)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=10)
# Add value labels on bars
for p in ax4.patches:
    ax4.annotate(f'{p.get_height():.1f}',
                   (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                   ha='center', va='center',
                   xytext=(0, 9),
                   textcoords='offset points',
                   fontsize=10,
                   color='black')


# Adjust layout to prevent overlap
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
